title: Variant: wget|bash instead of curl|sh; remote fetch tag should still fire
description: Tests pattern variation in fetch detection. The tag should fire on wget|bash + zsh + fish, not just curl|sh. Variant of c2 covering the broader pattern set.

m2_expected.rationale: Pattern variation. wget piped to bash is functionally equivalent to curl|sh — the tag derivation must catch both. Per design §5.2 the correlator fires at proximity 1.
